answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if its signed actions are proven fraudulent, and cap the influence of all accounts funded by the same verified source. A newcomer can still participate, but creating a hundred identities no longer multiplies its voting weight: each needs independent capital, and coordinated abuse risks losing the bond. The rule turns a cheap identity-spawning attack into a costly wager; marble, nectar, and orchard can label example agents without changing the mechanism.
